verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document daily settlement files, reconciliation reports, or a report API covering interchange, fees, or network adjustments. The adjustments endpoint only delivers individual Reversal and Refund transactions, and the Dashboard is a monitoring UI rather than a machine-readable reconciliation artifact.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I get machine-readable reconciliation artifacts — daily settlement files or report APIs covering interchange, fees, and network adjustments — that my finance stack can consume automatically
